#%Module
# Determin CPU SIMD
set cpu_flags [exec lscpu | grep "avx"]
if {[regexp "avx512_vnni" $cpu_flags]} {
    set avx_flag avx512
    system echo "AVX512 detected, utilizing the corresponding version..."
} elseif {[regexp "avx2" $cpu_flags]} {
    set avx_flag avx2
    system echo "No AVX512, but AVX2 detected, utilizing the corresponding version..."
} else {
    system echo "CAN NOT determin CPU SIMD, please contact the HPC Admin for help, Nya~~"
}

set ompi_ver "5.0.10"
set nvhpc_ver "26.3"
set ompi_cc "gnu"
set cudaver "12"
module-whatis "OpenMPI $ompi_ver build with NVHPC $nvhpc_ver ($ompi_cc & CUDA $cudaver) & UCC 1.7.0 & GDRCopy 2.5.0 & UCX 1.20.0, CPU SIMD - Auto Detect"

conflict openmpi

module load nvhpc/${nvhpc_ver}-${ompi_cc}-cuda${cudaver}-tuned

set mpi_dir /opt/devtools/openmpi/openmpi-${ompi_ver}-nvhpc263-${ompi_cc}-cuda${cudaver}-${avx_flag}

setenv OPAL_PREFIX          $mpi_dir
setenv PMIX_INSTALL_PREFIX  $mpi_dir
setenv OMPI_HOME            $mpi_dir
setenv MPI_HOME             $mpi_dir
setenv OSHMEM_HOME          $mpi_dir
setenv SHMEM_HOME           $

prepend-path PATH           $mpi_dir/bin
prepend-path LD_LIBRARY_PATH $mpi_dir/lib
prepend-path LIBRARY_PATH   $mpi_dir/lib
prepend-path CPATH          $mpi_dir/include
prepend-path C_INCLUDE_PATH $mpi_dir/include
prepend-path CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH $mpi_dir/include

setenv NO_STOP_MESSAGE 1
